archival_memory.warranty_policy:

- **Standard Warranty**: All our coffee machines come with a standard warranty of 1 year, covering any defects in materials and workmanship.

- **Dedicated Customer Support**: In the event of any issues or need for service, our dedicated customer support team is here to assist you promptly and efficiently.
